nodes.label: Pinned ML Stack (pandas 3.0.6, lightgbm 4.7.0, duckdb 1.5.5)
nodes.rationale: Python 3.12 venv deps including rapidfuzz, indic-transliteration, jellyfish, pytest; LightGBM is MIT and qualifies under the <=8B/license rule.

nodes.label: M2 Adoption Gates (numeric comparisons vs 0.8488)
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 adopt if held-out > 0.8488 and India not worse; Phase 2 if > Phase 1; Phase 3 if > Phase 2; Phase 4 if ceiling > 0.814 and net F0.5 > Phase 3; Phase 5 requires validator PASS.

nodes.label: Per-S1 Candidate Cap 200 + Per-Pass pass_caps
nodes.rationale: Union passes deduped then capped per S1 to bound the matcher input; _valid_sql applies pass caps, max_block unused.

nodes.label: Blocking + Classifier Approach (D1)
nodes.rationale: Naive 10^13 pair cross-product is infeasible; a hard blocking stage bounds the candidate set scored by a pairwise LightGBM classifier.

nodes.label: Blocking Recall Ceiling 0.814
nodes.rationale: Held-out candidate recall 1,240,887 of 1,524,017 truth pairs found; bounds the maximum achievable macro F0.5 and is the main future-work lever.

nodes.label: candidate_pairs.tsv Contract
nodes.rationale: Exact final pre-model candidate set (last blocking stage) that the model scores; matches must be a subset; not leaderboard-scored but used to audit recall ceiling and reduction.

nodes.label: Char N-Gram TF-IDF Cosine Features (D14)
nodes.rationale: Char 3-gram TF-IDF cosine for name_norm/name_roman/addr_norm captures typos and morphological variants token features miss; candidate set unchanged.

nodes.label: Colab T4 Embedding Stage (per-pair cosine)
nodes.rationale: Encode name_norm and addr_norm in 500k shards fp16, gather per pair, return emb_name_cos/emb_addr_cos; idempotent checkpoints, test file <= ~0.6 GB.

nodes.label: Colab Tesla T4 Probe (15.6 GB, fp16 only, 2 vCPU/13.6 GB)
nodes.norm_label: colab tesla t4 probe (15.6 gb, fp16 only, 2 vcpu/13.6 gb)
nodes.rationale: Verified 2026-09-26: Tesla T4 15,360 MiB, compute capability 7.5, CUDA, torch 2.11.0+cu128 preinstalled, free tier; no bf16 so use fp16, shard/checkpoint long jobs.

nodes.label: Cross-Encoder Rerank (mmarco-mMiniLMv2 / paraphrase-multilingual)
nodes.rationale: Reranks top-K candidates on Colab T4; Apache-2.0 118M, optional phase gated on held-out > prior phase.

nodes.label: Measured Dataset Facts (2.35 GiB, injective GT, 5.59% singletons)
nodes.norm_label: measured dataset facts (2.35 gib, injective gt, 5.59% singletons)
nodes.rationale: S1 2.21M/1.73M, S2 5.03M/4.89M, S3 5.29M/5.08M rows; 7,638,365 injective matches; mean 3.46 matches, max 11.

nodes.label: DuckDB Out-of-Core Blocking (D2)
nodes.rationale: Joins over 10M+ rows and 250-300M pairs must run in 23 GB RAM; stages stay restartable via parquet caches.

nodes.label: Full-Candidate Held-Out Validation (D9)
nodes.rationale: Report macro F0.5 on the complete candidate set of the 20% held-out S1 groups, predicted exactly as inference, because the 4:1 mark (0.9807) is optimistic.

nodes.label: Held-Out Full-Candidate F0.5 = 0.8488
nodes.rationale: 438,499 held-out S1 entities, 60.9M candidate pairs, 95% CI 0.8481-0.8496; believable in-domain estimate over-estimating leaderboard by ~0.04.

nodes.label: M2 Target: Held-Out > 0.90, Leaderboard > 0.85
nodes.rationale: Ceiling translates to ~0.95 macro F0.5; current 0.8488 is ~0.10 below, so matcher precision/recall is the lever before blocking.

nodes.label: Injective Ground Truth
nodes.rationale: No S2/S3 ID is claimed by two S1 entities, legitimizing a one-to-one assignment post-process for precision.

nodes.label: Kaggle Notebook Cascade N1-N6 (C+B)
nodes.rationale: clean -> block -> embed (GPU) -> GBDT -> rerank (GPU) -> decide; classical baseline ships alone with zero GPU quota, GPU stages cached as versioned datasets.

nodes.label: Leave-One-Country-Out France Proxy (D10)
nodes.rationale: France is ~15% of test and unlabeled; retrain US-only validate India and India-only validate US shows 0.09-0.12 F0.5 drop, bounding expectations at ~0.80-0.85.

nodes.label: LightGBM Matcher (D5)
nodes.rationale: Benchmarked tied with XGBoost on quality but trains 3-4.5x faster, which matters for local iteration; 610-tree model.

nodes.label: Local CPU Stages + Colab GPU Stages (D12)
nodes.norm_label: local cpu stages + colab gpu stages (d12)
nodes.rationale: Matcher/precision work is CPU- and data-bound (phases 0-1 and 5 local); embeddings/rerank are GPU-bound on free T4 (~20-50x faster for transformers). RULES.md 6 amended to allow both.

nodes.label: M2 Plan: 10 Tasks with Gates
nodes.rationale: diagnostic -> char n-gram -> per-country/singleton calibration -> retrain gate -> Colab export/import -> embeddings -> gate -> optional rerank -> conditional re-block -> rebuild/validate/package/submit.

nodes.label: Macro F0.5 Metric (beta=0.5, singletons included)
nodes.rationale: F0.5 = (1.25*P*R)/(0.25*P+R), averaged per Source 1 entity; precision weighted 2x so false merges are penalized more than missed matches.

nodes.label: matching_results.tsv Contract
nodes.rationale: Only leaderboard-scored file; one row per test S1 (1,732,544), empty list for singletons, S2/S3 IDs only, no duplicates.

nodes.label: Per-Token Metaphone Removed (D4)
nodes.rationale: Per-token phonetic codes collide massively (a generic code shared by >1.2M records), producing a 75 GiB temp explosion; recall recovered via prefix/pair passes.

nodes.label: Milestone Version Tags (1.4.0-2.0.0)
nodes.rationale: major.minor.bugs tagging; 1.3.0 leaderboard result, 1.4.0 M2 local diagnostic + features + calibration, 1.5.0 embeddings, 1.6.0 rerank, 1.7.0 re-block, 2.0.0 resubmission.

nodes.label: MinHash-LSH Re-Blocking (Task 9, conditional)
nodes.rationale: Adds blocking pass 11 (k=8 hashes, 4 bands) to raise the 0.814 ceiling; gated on net held-out F0.5 since re-blocking can lower precision.

nodes.label: intfloat/multilingual-e5-small Encoder
nodes.rationale: MIT, 118M/384-d; buys cross-script and France-generalization headroom while keeping the vector cache small.

nodes.label: 4:1 Negative Sampling (D6)
nodes.rationale: All positives plus negatives sampled 4:1 (half hard, half random country-matched) for fast training; threshold must be recalibrated (D8).

nodes.label: Official Leaderboard macro F0.5 = 0.811
nodes.rationale: Portal public test score submitted 26 Sep 2026 with one-to-one threshold 0.925; landed inside the predicted 0.80-0.85 band.

nodes.label: Injective One-to-One Post-Process (D7)
nodes.rationale: Ground truth is injective, so keep only the highest-probability assignment when several S1 claim the same candidate; lifted full-candidate F0.5 0.8475 to 0.8488.

nodes.label: Open-Set Country / Zero-Shot France
nodes.rationale: Train is US/India; test adds France (~15%) with no labels; never hard-code or one-hot country and every test entity must appear.

nodes.label: Oracle Ceiling Diagnostic (Task 1)
nodes.rationale: pred = truth ∩ candidates gives the matcher oracle; if oracle_macro - 0.8488 > 0.05 matcher work is the lever, else prioritize blocking.

nodes.label: 33-36 Pairwise Feature Set
nodes.rationale: Rapidfuzz name/address ratios, token Jaccard/containment, house/postal/state matches, script/roman signals, structural degree features; char n-gram and embedding cosines added in M2.

nodes.label: Per-Country Thresholds (D15)
nodes.rationale: US and India have different score distributions and F0.5 is precision-heavy and per-entity; tune US/India thresholds with a global fallback for unseen France.

nodes.label: Per-Pair Cosine Interface (D13)
nodes.rationale: Full embeddings for ~20M entities are ~15 GB fp16 exceeding free Drive; Colab returns only (s1_id, cand_id, emb_name_cos, emb_addr_cos) ~0.5 GB for test.

nodes.label: ber.cli Staged Pipeline (prepare/block/audit/features/train/predict)
nodes.rationale: Restartable parquet pipeline driven by ber.cli; DuckDB out-of-core joins plus pandas/pyarrow features and LightGBM.

nodes.label: Singleton Calibration (D15)
nodes.rationale: True singletons are worth 1.0 only if predicted empty; add a max-prob < tau decision and guard with LOO to avoid overfitting the unlabeled France slice.

nodes.label: Singleton Source-1 Entities (5.59%)
nodes.rationale: 123,247 train S1 have no matches; macro F0.5 awards 1.0 for a correct empty list and 0.0 for any false merge.

nodes.label: Spec-Compliant Submission Tree (D11)
nodes.rationale: Ship exactly output/, code/business_entity_resolution/ (src, README, requirements), and Documentation_template.md; model retrained from data, not shipped.

nodes.label: validate_submission.py Format Gate
nodes.rationale: Stdlib-only helper that checks both TSVs against every rule and must print PASS (exit 0) before any submission.

nodes.label: Ten Blocking Passes with Per-Pass Caps (D3)
nodes.norm_label: ten blocking passes with per-pass caps (d3)
nodes.rationale: Exact-name blocking recalls only ~22%; shared name-token prefix-5 covers ~89% and >=2 shared tokens ~78%, so union exact/rare-token/address-prefix/prefix/pair/triple passes then cap block sizes.

nodes.label: Operating Threshold 0.925 (D8/F12)
nodes.rationale: 4:1 sample suggested 0.675 but understates confusable negatives; re-tuned on full candidates the optimum moves to 0.925, producing 200,982 singletons and better precision.

nodes.label: Train Blocking Recall 0.8115 (US 0.868 / India 0.727)
nodes.rationale: Current operating point: 304.8M train candidates, reduction 29.5; India trails because Indic names and sparse addresses yield fewer shared rare tokens.
